research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: two first speeches, official CV, personal biography, union reporting, archived TasBuild/ALP biographies, TasBuild 2010 annual report, union 2004 financial return and corporate ownership research inspected.

Factory chronology is unresolved between frozen 1979, first speech July 1980 and later claim of 11 years. Private control is supported by Petersville commercial ownership history; full-time wording found only in an unofficial biography copy needs primary corroboration. No hours inferred from afternoon shift.

Union secretary end conflict is material: frozen 2010 and successor biography versus first-person May 2011. Preserve both leads. Wikipedia full-time organiser label was not located in the cited speech; do not import it as established evidence.

No public/private point total or zero justified. Earlier retail, aged-care and hospitality employers/control/hours remain unknown. Excluded governance/union/party terms can overlap factory work and each other without adding headline years.

Follow up primary historical biography for full-time wording, payroll/award evidence for actual factory status and breaks, pre-factory employer names, all governance appointment/pay dates, union amalgamation and exact secretary transition. Archived TasBuild 2005 report had no searchable Urquhart match; 2010 report resolved board exit.

Primary APH direct URL was restricted, but official indexed biography and accessible parliamentary speeches were retrieved. Annual-report aggregate FTEs and company-wide wages are not individual hours. No outreach or private-profile access used.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporary2010union return resolves state-secretary resignation to18August2010, independently consistent with2011return naming Short secretary. First-speech May2011statement retained; may refer to broader employment but no such explanation assumed. Added separately documented divisional executive role observed1January2011without invented term boundaries.

TasBuild CEO parliamentary evidenceJanuary2011describes sitting-fee routing to nominating organisations; does not prove Urquhart personal remuneration before July2010exit. Foundation primary news page returned InternalError; archived personal biography request inaccessible. Full-time factory wording remains only an unverified directory copy; no new hours or factory-start reconciliation.

Further follow-up should distinguish secretary office from any continuing paid union employment/leave, corroborate factory hours and1979/July1980conflict, and identify earlier retail/aged-care/hospitality employers. Governance records strengthen exclusions but do not make employment totals calculable.

Follow-up2026-10-04: exact-phrase searches found multiple current directory copies saying her full-time working life began in the late1970s, but none exposed provenance beyond a changed first-party biography; the current official page now says only working life and the2011first speech gives July1980. The copied wording was not promoted to substantive full-time evidence or used to resolve the date conflict. Employer-specific factory hours, seasonal breaks and early retail/aged-care/hospitality employers remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: ANU archival authority record identifies the intermediate Confectionery Workers and Food Preservers Union(1992)and1994Automotive Food Metals and Engineering Union successor. Refined organiser employer succession without inventing individual contract-transfer boundaries. Direct archival page returned502BadGateway; public index is explicitly cited. Australian Women’s Register entry created21September2010already calls her former secretary, corroborating the recorded2010resignation rather than resolving later continuing union employment. Factory1979/July1980conflict and full-time/seasonal leave remain unproved; earlier teenage employers not found. Next targeted evidence: factory personnel/award records, contemporary union employment following secretary resignation and archived first-party full-time biography.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: attempted original first-party archived AboutAnne page for copied full-time wording; web reader reports URL is not accessible via this tool, no code supplied. Current copies still lack verifiable provenance and are not independent FT proof. Identified new2023Advocatecareer interview but original returned402PaymentRequired; no bypass or subscriber contents used. Primary2011speech retains July1980factory start against frozen/union1979; aggregate union official/executive observations do not prove continuing paid employment after18August2010secretary resignation. Earlier retail/care/hospitality employer searches unresolved; unrelated mother/family/candidate facts not adopted. Next available public original interview, historical biography or personal payroll/appointment record, retaining exact source limitations.
